prepared_evidence.result: SNpp41 has 21 accepted chordotonal-organ rows and 1 same-type subclass=leg row; do not promote the systematic type as clean.

interpretation: SNpp39 and SNpp41 are literature/type-level FeCO hook candidates, but pinned MaleCNS v1.0 contains a mixed-subclass SNpp41 annotation: 21 SNpp41 rows pass the mechanosensory_proprioceptive/chordotonal-organ gate and 1 SNpp41 row is subclass=leg. NeuroFly records the hook pair for evidence review but does not promote SNpp41 as a clean exact-type stimulation population. Extension/flexion identity is also unresolved. Direction-specific stimulation and current calibration remain blocked.

rejected_candidates.reason: SNpp40/SNpp50/SNpp51 also occur in subclass=leg; SNpp51 additionally has a same-name unknown_sensory/leg row. Class/subclass gates were not relaxed.
